name: ryzhy_v2_press_a
prompt: The FIRST image is a sprite sheet of 8 frames (2 rows x 4 columns, read left to right, top row first); all 8 frames are the same picture of the orange tabby tomcat Ryzhy lying on his back pressing a barbell made of a wooden stick with two bundles of tin cans. Edit ONLY the masked area: redraw the arms and the barbell so the 8 frames become ONE smooth bench-press push: frame 1 stays EXACTLY as it is (the barbell on the chest), frames 2-8 push the barbell straight up in small, EVEN steps, frame 8 is the top: the arms extended up above the chest, the elbows only a little bent. The barbell is the same object in every frame: the same size, always horizontal, fully visible, the fists hold the stick between the can bundles at the same places as in frame 1. The arms keep EXACTLY their length and thickness from frame 1 (never longer, never thinner). VERY IMPORTANT: the head stays exactly where it is, looking the same way (to the right, three-quarter view), with EXACTLY the same facial expression as in frame 1 in all 8 frames: the same calm confident smirk, the same half-closed eyes and brows, closed mouth, no grimace, no teeth, no strain, no change of expression. The body, belly, legs and feet stay exactly as they are. Colours, fur and line weight exactly like the image. The background everywhere, also in the edited area, MUST be solid flat pure chroma-key GREEN (#00FF00), no shadow, no scenery, no text, no frame numbers.
